name: pulse
description: Pulse monorepo: desktop GUI, server, relay, runtime, shared contracts

scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.test: pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:py && pnpm test:spike && pnpm test:dev && pnpm test:schema && pnpm test:ipc && pnpm test:runtime-client
scripts.target-app:build: cd fixtures/target-app/flutter_module && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && cd .. && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintRelease assembleRelease
scripts.check: pnpm schema:check && pnpm ipc:check && pnpm runtime:client:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.runtime:build: uv sync --group package && uv run --group package python runtime/packaging/fetch_resources.py && uv run --group package pyinstaller runtime/packaging/pulse-runtime.spec --distpath dist/runtime --workpath build/pyinstaller --noconfirm && uv run --group package python runtime/packaging/smoke.py dist/runtime/pulse-runtime/pulse-runtime
